newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea to hand over 24 North Korean bodies.
newsitem.headline: South Korea to hand over 24 North Korean bodies.

text.p: South Korea on Monday will hand over the bodies of 24 North Koreans shot dead after landing by submarine in September, state radio reported.
The remains will be returned via the border village of Panmunjom at 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT).
Agreement on the handover came a day after Pyongyang apologised over the intrusion of its submarine into Southern waters. State radio said the bodies were now on their way to Panmunjom.

Details of transfer were agreed upon in a border meeting between officers of the United Nations Command and North Korean representatives. The U.N. body supervises a truce that ended the 1950-53 Korean War and is the main channel of communication between the rival Koreas.
The submarine set ashore 26 infiltrators. One was captured alive and one has never been found.
South Korea has ruled out returning the captured North Korean and the vessel, as Pyongyang has demanded.
